item.title: Pirates Attack Bahraini Boat Near Northern Maritime Border
item.description: The Bahrain Coast Guard reported that a Bahraini vessel carrying a 43-year-old Bahraini seaman and two Asian crew members, aged 36 and 38, was targeted by pirates near the Kingdom’s northern maritime border. According to the Coast Guard, upon receiving the report from the Main Operations Room, immediate measures were taken, and coordination with the relevant authorities was initiated. item.title: MPs Push For Bahrainisation In Public Pharmacies
item.description: Bahrain should restrict ownership of public pharmacies to Bahraini citizens, MPs have said in an urgent proposal that also calls for stronger checks on professional practice and a higher Bahrainisation rate in the sector. The proposal asks the government to regulate the pharmacy profession and public pharmacy centres in a way that limits ownership to Bahrainis, strengthens professional oversight and increases the share of Bahrainis working in pharmacy. item.description: Several municipal council chairmen, clerics and religious scholars have praised the directive of His Royal Highness Prince Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, to open, renovate and rehabilitate 60 mosques under the Sunni and Jaafari Endowments across all governorates of the Kingdom of Bahrain. item.title: Bahrain: Man Cleared Of Stealing Ex-Wife’s Gold And Gadgets
item.description: A man has been acquitted of stealing his ex-wife’s gold jewellery and electronic devices after a court found there was no evidence to support her claim. The woman went to a police station and accused her former husband of taking her gold jewellery, a mobile phone, an electronic watch and wireless earphones. item.title: Bahrain: Faulty New Car Sale Backfires As Court Orders BD8,000 Refund
item.description: Selling a faulty car has landed an authorised agent and a specialist car sales centre in trouble, with an appeal court ordering them to refund the customer BD8,000 and cancel the sale. The court ruled that the vehicle suffered from manufacturing defects that were never properly repaired, overturning an earlier judgment that had dismissed the buyer’s claim and ordered him to pay court costs. item.title: UAE Weather: Fog Alert Extended Through Thursday As Temperatures Rise
item.description: Fog and mist are expected to affect parts of the UAE through Thursday, with temperatures set to rise on Tuesday, according to the National Centre of Meteorology (NCM). item.title: Saudi Arabia Becomes First Arab Nation To Join Global AI Partnership
item.description: Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA) President Dr Abdullah Alghamdi announced that Saudi Arabia is the first Arab nation to join the Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence (GPAI). item.title: Emirates, Etihad Cancel More US–UAE Flights Amid Winter Storm
item.description: Emirates and Etihad Airways have cancelled additional flights to and from the United States on Monday as a powerful winter storm sweeps across the Northeast. The blizzard has prompted travel bans, flight suspensions and widespread shutdowns across major cities, including New York, New Jersey and Boston.
